sentences: Windfall Elimination Provision/Government Pension Offset.

Windfall Elimination Provision/Government Pension Offset Repealing the unfair, bureaucratic Windfall Elimination Provision and Government Pension Offset are among my top priorities for the 118th Congress.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Parents Bill of Rights Act
sentences: Mr. Chair, I rise today to join my voice with millions of American parents as the House considers H.R. 5, the Parents Bill of Rights Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Social Security Fairness
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today to express disappointment and frustration of thousands of my constituents after our effort to bring H.R. 82, the Social Security Fairness Act, to the floor for a vote, which was delayed this week.
The Windfall Elimination Provision and the Government Pension Offset are unfair, bureaucratic deductions that cheat nearly 2 million Americans out of their earned Social Security benefits.
These rules impact our public servants--the teachers who educate our children, firefighters and police officers who keep our communities safe.
I want to be clear, we are not trying to create new entitlement programs or forgive debt.
However, due to WEP and GPO, she is ineligible to receive his Social Security survivor benefits simply because she was a teacher.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Covid-19 American History Project Act
sentences: For families like mine, that loss means an empty chair at the dinner table, a son who won't be able to go fishing with his dad anymore, and a daughter who won't be able to dance with her father on her wedding day.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Providing for Consideration of H.R. 6119, Further Extending Government Funding Act; and for Other Purposes
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise to oppose the previous question so we can immediately take up H.R. 6056, the Parents Bill of Rights Act.
Parents should not have a system of values and beliefs forced on their children or send them to school while fearing indoctrination by a political agenda.
The Parents Bill of Rights Act puts safeguards in place that ensure that the foundation of education is built on a meaningful dialogue between a family and their child's school.
In my home State of Louisiana, a similar parents bill of rights passed with broad support from both Republicans and Democrats, and I hope we can follow suit here in Congress.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Family Violence Prevention and Services Improvement Act of 2021
sentences: First, this bill opens the door for entities to spend taxpayer dollars on abortions.

Secondly, it forces an unnecessary conversation about sexual orientation and gender identity when these issues have never been a part of this bill before and should not be a barrier between people and the services they need.
That is why my amendment also rejects a change included in the Democrats' proposal that could lead to violence prevention dollars going to support abortion services.
The amendment makes clear that Federal law should not support abortions.
Upholding the sanctity of every human life is of utmost importance, and it is critical to ensure that no taxpayer dollars pay for abortions.
Countless religious organizations work tirelessly to help protect victims of domestic violence, but the Democrats' radical abortion agenda risks denying victims' access to these providers.
Furthermore, it is a pro-life amendment strongly opposed by Planned Parenthood.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Women'S Health Protection Act of 2021
sentences: However, before I talk about the amendment, I think it is important for the House to note that the legislation before us is perhaps the most extreme abortion measure that Congress has ever considered.
It will overturn countless protections for the unborn that States have already put into place, including those in my home State of Louisiana.

Intimately knowing the special bond that grows between a mother and a child over those 9 months, I do not understand how we can pass this bill, a law that will allow an abortion to be performed up until the actual moment of birth, despite the fact that the child has a fully developed heart and can feel pain.
The amendment I am bringing forward is the text of the Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act in which my distinguished colleague from Missouri, Ann Wagner, has been an outstanding leader.
It would ensure that newborn children who survive an abortion are given the same crucial, lifesaving medical care that any infant would receive.
I have always considered myself to be pro-life, but I never truly understood the sanctity of life until that moment.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Providing for Consideration of H.R. 2062, Protecting Older Workers Against Discrimination Act of 2021; Providing for Consideration of H.R.
sentences: Madam Speaker, I rise to oppose the previous question so that we can amend the rule to allow the consideration of H.R. 18, the No Taxpayer Funding for Abortion Act.
This critical bill will finally codify the Hyde amendment and uphold the longstanding bipartisan agreement that prevents taxpayer dollars from funding abortions.

While Republicans and Democrats have engaged in heated debates over abortion in the past 40 years, we were always able to agree on the simple principle that public funding should not be used for abortions.
The Hyde amendment, which explicitly spelled this policy out, has been included in every single appropriations bill since 1976, including those passed under the Clinton and Obama administrations.
When I arrived in Congress a few months ago, one of my first actions was to sign on to H.R. 18, the No Taxpayer Funding for Abortion Act.
Taxpayer dollars should not be used to fund abortions.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: Pregnant Workers Fairness Act
sentences: For example, a faith-based employer could be deemed in violation of this bill if it does not accommodate an employee's request for paid time off to undergo an abortion.
When it comes to religious freedom and pro-life issues, we should not allow bureaucrats and potentially the judicial system to make decisions by reading between the lines.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: National Police Week
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today during National Police Week to honor the 394 law enforcement officers whose names have been forever engraved into the National Law Enforcement Officers Memorial here in Washington, D.C. I am honored to join Congressman Michael Guest and 90 of my Republican colleagues in introducing a resolution to recognize these brave men and women who made the ultimate sacrifice.

Fifteen law enforcement officers from Louisiana were killed in the line of duty in 2020, including four from the Fifth Congressional District: Kejuana Artez Bates with the Vidalia Police Department; Kietrell Michael Pitts with the Tangipahoa Sheriff's Office; Randy Michael Vallot with the Richland Parish Sheriff's Office; and Marshal Lee Walter, Jr., with the Mangham Police Department.
We thank all law enforcement officers and their families for their sacrifice, and ask God to bless each and every one of you.
